featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first time getting my nails done in Mumbai, and I was really looking for someone who’s skilled, while also maintaining top-notch hygiene and quality standards — and I’m so glad I found Nishita.

Nishita has a super cute studio in Dahisar West, and her hygiene standards are honestly impressive. Everything — from her tools to the workspace — is well maintained and clean. She’s incredibly quick, gentle, and her finishing is beautiful.

From the removal of my previous gel polish, to nail shaping, product selection, and application, every step was handled with care and precision.
I got French tips on my toenails and cat-eye nails on my fingers, and she completed everything in just 1.5 hours — which is amazing considering the detailing involved!

Highly recommend her services if you’re looking for clean, professional, and stunning nail work
